records.title: A lightweight data-driven spiking neuronal network model of Drosophila olfactory nervous system with dedicated hardware support

decisions.notes: The model targets olfaction and associative learning and runs on FPGA hardware. It does not model nociception, whole-brain dynamics, pain or human transfer.
